preflight.expectedAffectedRows: No rows are rewritten or deleted; lifecycle and audit columns, one NOT VALID status constraint, and employer-scoped indexes are added

execution.resumeStrategy: Rerun the additive IF NOT EXISTS column and index statements, then confirm the named canonical status constraint exists
execution.idempotency: Columns and indexes use IF NOT EXISTS; known legacy status constraints are dropped before the canonical named constraint is recreated

quarantine.strategy: No tenant ownership or lifecycle status is inferred; legacy rows remain untouched for explicit review before constraint validation

constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Inspect noncanonical statuses, confirm new writers accept only the six canonical states, then validate the status constraint in a separately reviewed migration

recovery.rollback: Stop using filled and archived writers; leave additive nullable columns and indexes in place and restore the previous status constraint only in a forward migration
recovery.forwardFix: Normalize any explicitly reviewed legacy status rows and validate the canonical constraint in a later additive migration
